extension.summary: Opens the Resonuls app, on its own
extension.description: The Resonuls app full screen, apart from Kodi's music: its home of covers, its lists and its search, with what plays at the top. Pick it for an entry of your skin's main menu.

L'app Resonuls en plein écran, à part de la musique de Kodi : son accueil de pochettes, ses listes et sa recherche, avec ce qui joue en haut. Choisis-la pour une entrée du menu principal de ton habillage.
extension.news: 1.0.0: the Resonuls app, to open from your skin's main menu.
